span.p:
Batch 8 to 32
one team, interactive latency

div.style: color: rgb(92, 46, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Sizing: weights + KV cache + activations.
KV ≈ batch × context × layers × 2 × kv_heads × head_dim × bytes/elem.
Long context at high batch exhausts memory
long before the weights do.

div.style: color: rgb(92, 46, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Prefill is compute bound.
Decode is memory bandwidth bound.
Batching them together makes both worse.
